payload.reason: The evidence indicates that using the BookTest dataset significantly improves the performance of the Attention-Sum Reader model compared to smaller datasets, specifically the Children's Book Test.

claims.text: Training on the BookTest dataset improves the accuracy of the Attention-Sum Reader model on the original CBT test data by a much larger margin than many recent attempts to improve the model architecture.
The Attention-Sum Reader model was able to exceed human performance on the CBT CN dataset when trained with the BookTest dataset.
Using more training data, such as the BookTest, is more effective for improving model performance than solely enhancing the model architecture.
